what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Bangladesh, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 582991 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's file reports no internally displaced people for Bangladesh; in UNHCR's data that can mean none, or none reported.

why.text: The sources here say little about the causes: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017, and an earlier conflict over the government with the PBCP in 2005 and 2006.
Floods, storms and erosion are the disasters recorded for Bangladesh in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure changed slowly, from 426490 in 2009 to a peak of 584836 in 2024.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2017, and very few in 2025.

how.text: In 2025 disasters caused far more new displacements than conflict: IDMC recorded 105169 from disasters.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
Refugees from Bangladesh live mainly in France, Canada and the United Kingdom.
The sources don't say where inside Bangladesh people moved to.
